invariants.note: NOTHING WAS REFUTED THIS ROUND AND THAT IS NOT THE SAME AS NOTHING BEING WRONG. Four defects in R5's own gate were found by the audit and reproduced here before any change: consume() accepted a single witness for an arbitrary universal, two conditional gates checked field presence rather than a proof, and a soft objective's instrument resolved to nothing. Those are defects in a mechanism, not false propositions, so they leave no REFUTED record behind — which is itself worth noticing about what this ledger can and cannot represent.
